heard: A federal law banned Chinese astronauts from the ISS. That exclusion only forced a rival laboratory into the sky. China launched the massive Tianhe core module in 2021. They docked two giant experiment modules to complete the station. 17 different countries now conduct research on this forbidden outpost. European astronauts even joined their crew for deep sea survival training. Their new telescope dwarfs Hubble with a field of view 300 times wider. This rival program was born because of that federal law.
